question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**value**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is the **story** of '**The Grasshopper and the Ant'**.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**value**'.
 
• In the given context the word '**value**' means 'to consider something important or good (किसी महत्वपूर्ण या अच्छी बात पर विचार करना)'.
 
 
• *Example: We **value** our partnership with the government.*
 
 
 
• Here, the word '**value**' is referring to **a lesson.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
